title: India tops the developing world's jobs challenge
unit: million young people reaching working age, 2025-35

metadata.note: Top 10 emerging market and developing economies by the 'youth method' jobs challenge: the number of young people (aged 15-24 in 2035) reaching working age over 2025-35. India leads at ~238 million, ahead of China (~169m) and Nigeria (~61m). Source: World Bank, The Global Jobs Challenge (2026), Figure 2.8.A; underlying data UN World Population Prospects 2024. Projections, not measurements.
metadata.sourceLine: World Bank, The Global Jobs Challenge (2026 advance edition). CC BY 3.0 IGO.
